objective: Compare constant differential learning rates with the exp007 cached-native v123 DDP batch4 recipe from the public VoxTell v1.1 checkpoint

initialization.load_policy: resolve the public model through download_voxtell_model; do not initialize from exp006, exp007, or another fine-tuned checkpoint
initialization.optimizer_resume: resume only between Exp026 five-epoch barriers

preprocessing.normalization: orientation fix, crop-to-nonzero, full cropped-volume z-score once, then native-resolution patch/window sampling
preprocessing.scientific_difference_from_exp007: learning-rate schedule only; preprocessing, model input, sampler, and loss are unchanged

schedule.prompt_policy: multi-finding 2 positive + 1 negative; one-finding 1 positive + 2 negatives; every selected positive nonempty in its sampled patch

training.augmentation: none added beyond VoxTell patch sampling

validation.eval_policy: training pauses at each five-epoch segment; val200 inference is sharded over all four GPUs; fixed JSON is passed directly

comparison_plan.primary_baseline: exp007 original public-start cached-native v123 DDP batch4
comparison_plan.primary_checkpoint: Exp026 epoch100 val200 versus exp007 epoch100 val200
comparison_plan.controlled_difference: poly power-0.9 schedule with 100-update warmup in exp007 versus fixed differential learning rates with zero warmup in Exp026
